--- pipe_rename.sql
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT * FROM Singers
  |> RENAME FirstName AS given_name, LastName family_name,
)

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Select{
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.Star{
        Star: 7,
      },
    },
    From: &ast.From{
      From:   9,
      Source: &ast.SubQueryTableExpr{
        Lparen: 14,
        Rparen: 99,
        Query:  &ast.Query{
          Query: &ast.Select{
            Select:  18,
            Results: []ast.SelectItem{
              &ast.Star{
                Star: 25,
              },
            },
            From: &ast.From{
              From:   27,
              Source: &ast.TableName{
                Table: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 32,
                  NameEnd: 39,
                  Name:    "Singers",
                },
              },
            },
          },
          PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
            &ast.PipeRename{
              Pipe:  42,
              Items: []*ast.PipeRenameItem{
                &ast.PipeRenameItem{
                  Old: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 52,
                    NameEnd: 61,
                    Name:    "FirstName",
                  },
                  As:  62,
                  New: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 65,
                    NameEnd: 75,
                    Name:    "given_name",
                  },
                },
                &ast.PipeRenameItem{
                  Old: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 77,
                    NameEnd: 85,
                    Name:    "LastName",
                  },
                  As:  -1,
                  New: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 86,
                    NameEnd: 97,
                    Name:    "family_name",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM Singers |> RENAME FirstName AS given_name, LastName family_name)
